verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is mainly an open-source client-side rendering engine, but it also runs hosted services such as the Playground, which saves and shares code snippets. Data retention and deletion is therefore a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion controls or privacy policy for any Babylon.js service or the library itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
